convertibility_reason: Uses a custom neural network class loaded from external .mqh library (NeuroNetwork.mqh or similar). iCustom indicator calls and non-standard indicator logic require manual translation of the neural network forward-pass, weight initialization, and training/inference pipeline into Python.

derived_values.name: MACD histogram value fed as neural network input
Neural network output signal
derived_values.formula: sigmoid(W3 * relu(W2 * relu(W1 * inputs + b1) + b2) + b3)

other_exits: Neural network signal reversal triggers close of current position before opening opposite

custom_logic_notes: The neural network is pre-trained or trained on historical data using backpropagation. Input features include MACD values, price changes, and possibly RSI or momentum derivatives. The network output is a sigmoid-activated signal between 0 and 1; values above 0.5 suggest long, below 0.5 suggest short. MACD serves as a confirming filter: both NN and MACD must agree on direction for entry. On signal reversal, existing position is closed before new position is opened in the opposite direction.
python_conversion_notes: The neural network class must be reimplemented in Python (numpy/tensorflow/pytorch). Weight matrices and bias vectors need to be extracted from the .mqh file or retrained. The MACD component is trivial (use ta-lib or pandas-ta). Critical: the NN input feature vector construction must be replicated exactly, including normalization/scaling of MACD and price inputs before feeding into the network. The sigmoid threshold at 0.5 and AND-logic with MACD direction must be preserved. No tick-level logic required so bar-based backtesting with M1 data is sufficient.
